Replace placeholders in a Markdown / Quarto document

replace.Rd

Replace tokens of the form <placeholder_prefix>_<slug> using scalars or content_spec from define_content(). Execution is deferred to knitr/Quarto.

Marker behavior

One (and only one) marker is emitted per replacement, independent of draft_mode, controlled by marker_mode:

  • "hidden" (default): [token]{custom-style="PlaceholderMarker"}

  • "show": [token]{custom-style="PlaceholderMarkerVisible"}

  • "off": (no marker)

For DOCX, define both character styles in your reference DOCX. For HTML, hide hidden markers by including the following CSS in your document: span[custom-style="PlaceholderMarker"] { display: none !important; }

Draft mode

If draft_mode = TRUE, the placeholder is bookended with markers. For example, a block would appear as:

--DRAFT_CONTENT--
<marker if any>
<content>
--END_DRAFT_CONTENT--

Usage

replace(
  markdown_file,
  placeholder_prefix = "placeholder_content",
  code_content = list(),
  draft_mode = TRUE,
  draft_mode_prefix = "--DRAFT_CONTENT--",
  draft_mode_suffix = "--END_DRAFT_CONTENT--",
  validation_path = NULL,
  marker_mode = c("hidden", "show", "off"),
  placeholder_style_hidden = "PlaceholderMarker",
  placeholder_style_visible = "PlaceholderMarkerVisible",
  log_file = "quality_log.csv",
  html_file = "validation.html",
  output_file_ext = "md"
)

Arguments

markdown_file

Path to the Markdown/Quarto file (overwritten).

placeholder_prefix

Character prefix identifying the placeholder. Defaults to "placeholder_content".

code_content

Named list mapping slugs to scalars or content_spec. Defaults to an empty list.

draft_mode

Logical; if TRUE, wrap in plain draft markers. Defaults to TRUE.

draft_mode_prefix, draft_mode_suffix

Strings for draft boundaries. Defaults to "--DRAFT_CONTENT--" and "--END_DRAFT_CONTENT--" respectively.

validation_path

Optional directory for a CSV log of what has been replaced. Setting this to NULL disables the creation of the log. Defaults to NULL.

marker_mode

Controls the styling, if any, applied to placeholder markers. One of:

  • "hidden" (default) where markers are included but the PlaceholderMarker style is applied, for example, [placeholder_content_value]{custom-style="PlaceholderMarker"},

  • "show" where markers are included and the PlaceholderMarkerVisible style is applied, for example, [placeholder_content_value]{custom-style="PlaceholderMarkerVisible"},

  • "off" where no styling is applied. For example, placeholder_content_value. The names of the relevant styles are defined in placeholder_style_hidden and placeholder_style_visible.

placeholder_style_hidden, placeholder_style_visible

The names of the styles used for hidden/visible markers as applied in marker_mode. Defaults to "PlaceholderMarker" and "PlaceholderMarkerVisible" respectively. An example of a Word document with these styles is included within the package. Run the following code to access it:


path <- system.file("extdata", "PlaceholderMarker_example.docx",
                    package = "knittogether")
utils::browseURL(path)
log_file

CSV log file name (within validation_path) to be generated and to read (if already exists). If NULL the log is not generated. Defaults to "quality_log.csv".

html_file

HTML report file name (within validation_path) to be generated. If this already exists it will be overwritten. If NULL the report is not generated. Default: "validation.html".

output_file_ext

The extension for the output file. Typically, 'md' but Quarto can sometimes raise errors if it detects executable code in markdown and require a '.qmd' file instead, regardless of whether there is executable code present. Defaults to 'md'.

Value

Invisibly returns the updated Markdown (character vector).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
spec <- define_content(
  description     = "A plot of mtcars",
  placeholder_id  = "mtcarsplot",
  output_mode     = "chunk",
  content         = { plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg) },
  content_type    = "plot",
  chunk_options   = list(echo = FALSE, fig.width = 7)
)
code_map <- placeholder_map(specs = list(spec))
replace(
  markdown_file = "markdown_output.md",
  placeholder_prefix = "placeholder_content",
  code_content = code_map,
  draft_mode = TRUE,
  draft_mode_prefix = "--DRAFT_CONTENT--",
  draft_mode_suffix = "--END_DRAFT_CONTENT--",
  validation_path = "validation",
  marker_mode = "hidden",
  placeholder_style_hidden = "PlaceholderMarker",
  placeholder_style_visible = "PlaceholderMarkerVisible"
  )
} # }
